title: Regional advantage in rugby sevens: Is there a home effect when nobody is home?
abstract: arXiv:2608.16312v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the existence of a \emph{Regional Differential} in rugby sevens: whether, in tournaments where no competing team enjoys formal home status, some national sides systematically over- or under-perform depending on \emph{where} the event is staged. Using the universe of 2672 men's and women's matches from international rugby sevens tournaments played between 2016 and 2025, principally the World Rugby Sevens Series, but also the World Cup Sevens and the Olympic Games, we replace the binary ``locality'' indicator of the classic home advantage literature with continuous measures of geographic, temporal, and cultural proximity between each team and the host country. We show that aggregate associations between proximity and performance (which appear large and highly significant in naive specifications) are almost entirely an artifact of \emph{team composition} and \emph{scheduling}: once team and opponent quality are absorbed through fix

translated_title: 七人制橄榄球中的区域优势：当没有主队时，是否存在主场效应？
translated_abstract: 我们研究了七人制橄榄球中是否存在“区域差异”：在没有任何参赛队伍享有正式主场地位的比赛中，一些国家队是否会根据赛事举办地点而系统性地表现超常或失常。我们使用了2016年至2025年间国际七人制橄榄球锦标赛的2672场男女比赛数据，主要来自世界七人制橄榄球系列赛，也包括七人制橄榄球世界杯和奥运会。我们将经典主场优势文献中的二元“本地性”指标替换为每支队伍与主办国之间的地理、时间和文化邻近性的连续度量。我们表明，邻近性与表现之间的总体关联（在简单设定中看似显著且规模巨大）几乎完全是“队伍构成”和“赛程安排”的产物：一旦通过固定效应吸收队伍和对手的实力，这种关联便消失。
tldr: 本研究揭示七人制橄榄球中看似存在的区域优势实为队伍构成和赛程安排的伪影，真正的主场效应在无主队赛事中并不存在。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that apparent regional advantages in rugby sevens are artifacts of team composition and scheduling, with no genuine home effect in tournaments where no team has formal home status.
